infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for the Lady Gaga The MAYHEM Ball Tour
infoLinks.content:
From 7am to 8.30am, then from 3pm to 4.15pm, on Friday 12 December, school routes 665s, 760s and 761s services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Lady Gaga concerts.
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Lady Gaga event page for more details.

infoLinks.content:

  • Alternative bus routes operating via Gregory Hills Drive and Town Centre include:
    • For travel to Minto, passengers can travel to Campbelltown Station via Route 840 and change to the T8 South and Airport Line.
    • For travel between Oran Park and Gregory Hills, passengers can use bus route 840.
    • For travel to Narellan passengers can use bus route 841. Timetable changes will also affect this route.
  • Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

• From Sunday 31 August, Route 850 services will no longer operate via Gregory Hills Drive to Gregory Hills Town Centre, instead it will operate via Camden Valley Way providing customers with a more efficient trip.
  • Alternative bus routes operating via Gregory Hills Drive and Town Centre include:
    • For travel to Minto, passengers can travel to Campbelltown Station via Route 840 and change to the T8 South and Airport Line.
    • For travel between Oran Park and Gregory Hills, passengers can use bus route 840.
    • For travel to Narellan passengers can use bus route 841. Timetable changes will also affect this route.
  • Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.
subtitle: Route 850 is changing from 31 August

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for the Lady Gaga The MAYHEM Ball Tour
infoLinks.content:
From 7pm Thursday 11 December to 3am Sunday 14 December, routes 525 and 526 services will be diverting while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for the Lady Gaga concerts.
 
Services in both directions will be diverting via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Lady Gaga event page for more details.
 
Closed and alternative stops
  • Park Street opposite Olympic Park Station (212790)
    • Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue opposite Olympic Park Station (212791)
    • Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue (212788)
    • Alternative stop: Edwin Flack Avenue opposite Accor Stadium (212735)
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue (212787)
    • Alternative stop: Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Avenue (212736)
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Avenue (212792)
    • Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712)

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.
infoLinks.subtitle: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May

urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.
subtitle: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta bus diversions for A-League match
infoLinks.content:
Road closures will be in place from 9:30pm to 10pm approximately on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd on Saturday 29 November following an A-League match at CommBank Stadium.
 
The following bus stops will be closed and routes 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 will be diverting while road closures are in place. Walk to nearby alternative stops, see the road closure and transport map for more details:
 
Closed and alternative stops:
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed
    • Alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills and North West)
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed
    • Alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road after Villiers Street will be closed
    • Alternative stop All Saints Anglican Church, Victoria Road (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road before Marist Place will be closed
    • Alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park) 
Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info

infoLinks.urlText: Bus service improvements in Sydney’s North West from Sunday 30 November
infoLinks.content:
Route 616X Kellyville Ridge to City QVB (Express Service) will have timetable changes:
  • Some morning peak services will now start at Stanhope Village Shopping Centre to better match passenger demand.
  • Adjustments to spacing of peak trips to better balance loadings during this period and reduce capacity pressure on individual trips.
  • Minor timetable changes will be introduced to improve service reliability and reflect operating conditions.
For more information see the news story.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD Martin Place diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
From 11.45am until 3pm on Saturday 29 November, route 389 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures for a planned Police Operation protest march. 
 
Buses travelling towards Bondi Junction will divert via Pyrmont Bridge Road, Western Distributor, Bathurst Street, Elizabeth Street to return to route on Park Street.  
 
Buses travelling towards Pyrmont will divert via College Street, Wentworth Avenue, Goulburn Street, Elizabeth Street, Liverpool Street, Kent Street, Druitt Street, Western Distributor and Pyrmont Bridge Road to return to route on Harris Street.  
 
Check signs at stops and allow extra travel time.  
 
Missed stops: 
  • Harris St at Allen St (200933) 
  • Sussex St after King St (2000228) 
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand H (2000249) 
  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand C (2000412) 
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand J (2000425) 
  • Harris St after Allen St (200926)

infoLinks.urlText: Surry Hills bus diversions for Christmas Fair
infoLinks.content:
From 7am until 11:30pm on Saturday 13 December, route 304 services will be diverting around Crown St and missing stops between Albion St and Cleveland St while road closures are in place for the City of Sydney’s Surry Hills Christmas Fair Services towards the City will be diverting via Cleveland St, Chalmers St, Randle St, Elizabeth St and Albion St.
 
Services away from the City will be diverting via Albion St, Flinders St, South Dowling St and Cleveland St.
 
Use alternative stops further along Crown St or Baptist St. Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. 
 
Missed stops:
  • Crown St opp Lansdowne St (stop ID 201098)
  • Crown St at Miles St (stop ID 201021)
  • Crown St opp Rainford St  (Stop ID 201022)
  • Crown St at Rainford St (stop ID 201092)
  • Crown St before Foveaux St (stop ID 201023)
  • Shannon Reserve, Crown St (stop ID 201093)

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus service improvements in Sydney’s North West from Sunday 30 November
infoLinks.content:
Route 665 Rouse Hill Station to Parramatta will have timetable adjustments, more services:
  • Route 665 (Parramatta to Rouse Hill) will be upgraded to become part of the All Day Frequent Network (ADFN), with services to run every 10 minutes or better during the day and every 20 minutes or better early morning and late evening, seven days a week. Route 665 will also operate 24 hours on Friday and Saturday nights, introducing new overnight services between Parramatta and Rouse Hill.
  • There will be higher capacity buses operating during peak periods to better match passenger demand.
  • Changes to running times to better reflect journey times along the North West T-Way
For more information see the news story.

Services in both directions will be diverting via Hill Road, Pondage Link, Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Holker Busway.
 
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the Lady Gaga event page for more details.

infoLinks.urlText: Opal can be used between Wollongong and Moss Vale, Exeter and Bundanoon stations.
infoLinks.content:
If travelling by Coach between Wollongong station and Moss Vale, Exeter or Bundanoon stations you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

Buses leaving the city will start trips from Wynyard Station, Clarence St, Stand R (2000142).

infoLinks.urlText: L1, L2, L3 light rail services may be temporarily held at stops or partially closed due to a Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 29 November, L1 Dulwich Hill Line, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services may be impacted between 12pm and 3pm approximately for two planned Police Operation protest marches:  
  • L1 services may be temporarily held at stops, or partially closed between Central Grand Concourse and Convention, or 
  • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall or Central.  
Impact to services and timings may change at the direction of NSW Police. 
 
Please check information screens at stops, listen to announcements and follow the direction of staff or Police on site, as necessary. 
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner for alternative transport options, including trains, buses or walking.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight full closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 1 to Wednesday 3 December, nightly from 9pm to 1am, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines light rail services will not run due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.

During this time, use alternative transport including:
  • Replacement bus services or regular bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford,
  • Use trains, buses or walk if able to, between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
  • Please note on Monday 1 and Tuesday 2 December, nightly from 9.40pm to 1.30am, trains do not run on the City Circle.
  • See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Allow extra travel time as Kiss and Ride upgrade is underway at Leppington Station
infoLinks.content:
Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
  • A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
  • A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
  • Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.
  • Work will take place between 7am to 6pm, Monday to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays.
Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.
